summary: Completed comprehensive testing of attribution refresh and trigger_audience features. Backend tests: 36/36 PASS (100%). Frontend: Code review confirms all UI elements present with correct data-testids. Fixed critical bug where attribution_history and attribution_refreshed_at fields were not being returned by API (Pydantic model missing fields).

fixed_bugs.issue: attribution_history and attribution_refreshed_at not returned by GET /api/contacts/{id}
fixed_bugs.root_cause: ContactDetail, ContactWithStats, and Contact Pydantic models missing the new fields (attribution_history, attribution_refreshed_at, first_identified_at)
fixed_bugs.fix: Added missing fields to all three models in server.py
fixed_bugs.verification: MongoDB query confirmed data was being persisted correctly; API now returns all fields

passed_tests: BACKEND 1: Attribution refresh on same browser with new fbclid - fbclid updated from OLD1 to NEW1, fbc updated, utm_campaign updated, attribution_history has 1 entry with old values, attribution_refreshed_at timestamp set
BACKEND 2: Cross-device return with email stitch - Contact B stitched to Contact A, attribution refreshed with NEW2 fbclid, history archived
BACKEND 3: No false refresh when same fbclid sent - attribution unchanged, history did not grow
BACKEND 4: trigger_audience CRUD - Create with 'returning' (201), Update to 'new' (200), Invalid value 'bogus' rejected (400), GET returns field, Default is 'both'

BACKEND 5: Automation firing logic - NEW automation fired for new contact only, RETURNING automation fired for returning contact only, BOTH automation fired for both scenarios, dedup key includes fbclid
BACKEND 6: Stealth webhook regression - POST with new email creates contact (200), POST with same email returns same contact_id (no duplicate)
BACKEND 7: Regression tests - GET /api/automations (200), GET /api/contacts (200), GET /api/stats (200)

FRONTEND: Code review confirms trigger_audience Select present with data-testid='trigger-audience-select', options have correct data-testids (trigger-audience-new, trigger-audience-returning, trigger-audience-both), AutomationsPage shows trigger_audience badge

success_percentage.frontend: Code review: 100% (all UI elements present with correct implementation)
